result.summary: Reviewed git diff main...HEAD for scripts/test_parallel.sh (new file, includes rework commits dc93092/cf28a46). Rework only changes ExUnit summary parsing (grep/sed/awk against fixed anchored patterns '^Result: ', '^Failed: ') and the exit-code/failure-count cross-check logic. No DB/Ecto call, no HTTP call, no migration, no API route, no secret resolution (TEST_PARALLEL_N/MIX_TEST_PARTITION are partition-count knobs, not credentials), no response shaping for a tenant-scoped entity, no lookup-by-ID handler. All file writes are confined to the mktemp -d tmp_dir (partition-N.log); no eval or execution of parsed/untrusted mix-test-output content -- it is only grepped/summed as data, so adversarial partition output can at worst corrupt the aggregated counts, not gain code execution or escape the tmpdir. Scope test conclusion unchanged from the prior pass: out of scope -- no tenant-data path touched. INV-1..INV-8 not individually run per the scope-test negative-gate rule.
